title: Make evals the backbone of an AI product
goal: Explain why evals decide AI product reliability, build one from data, task and scores, and know where offline evals and monitoring each fall short.

title: Price an AI product, from seats to outcomes
goal: Explain how AI pricing differs from SaaS and choose a pricing model, including outcome-based pricing.

title: Design the UX of an AI product
goal: Apply a practical design model, trust patterns and a declarative generative UI approach to an AI product.

title: Decide where AI belongs in your product
goal: Choose where AI adds value, commit to it, and keep a product fit as models change.

title: Run a product team that ships with AI
goal: Describe how AI-first teams prototype, build and organize to ship faster.

title: How attention lets a transformer read text
goal: Explain how queries, keys and values let each token take meaning from context, and why masking and parallelism matter.

title: From raw text to a chat assistant
goal: Describe the training stages that turn internet text into an aligned assistant, from pre-training to RL.

title: How a model turns tokens into output text
goal: Explain tokenization, probability distributions and the sampling settings that shape generated text.

title: Give an LLM tools, context and skills
goal: Set up an agent that manages its context window, calls tools and improves through reusable skill files.

title: A disciplined workflow for coding with AI agents
goal: Run an AI coding task from shared understanding through small tickets, tests and review.

title: Know where LLMs and coding agents fall short
goal: Judge when to trust LLM output and where agentic coding still needs expert guidance.

title: What interpretability shows inside language models
goal: Explain what researchers have found inside models about shared concepts, planning, faithful reasoning and hallucination.

title: The case for world models beyond text
goal: Explain why some researchers think text-only LLMs are not enough and what world models and planning would add.
